title: Runtime capability model
content: Runtime capability model Implemented CapabilitySnapshot , ModelCapability , GpuCapability , and RuntimeCapabilityFlags to support future deterministic scheduler scoring and policy eligibility checks. Current phase defines contracts only; it does not change inference routing behavior
